_comment: Release manifest. `runners` is the ONE table of runner-image pins: key = hal0 runner key (src/hal0/runners/__init__.py RUNNER_IMAGES), `image` = registry repo, `tag` = immutable tag, `digest` = sha256 content digest, `lanes_gated` = backends that passed the hardware gate for this digest. Every other runner-image fact in hal0 (Runner.image, the Vulkan-capable set, exports/runner-image-pins.json, the bench harness, `hal0 doctor toolbox-pull`, installer/lib/preflight.sh) is derived from this table. `tag: null` marks an image that is not published yet; `digest: null` pulls by tag. scripts/release-check.sh refuses a release while any default-tier runner has a null tag or digest (hal0.runners.pins.release_gate_problems). Bump pins by editing this table only.
_upgrade_from_notes: PEP 440 specifier for the versions this release upgrades from. release.yml copies it into every channel manifest, where the updater enforces it (updater._enforce_upgrade_floor); installer/install.sh enforces it on a re-run over an existing install. A box below it must step through a release inside the window or reinstall.
